title: Enhancing diabetes therapy with pH-sensitive co-delivery of metformin hydrochloride and glipizide using MCM-48-based dual drug delivery system
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,7191-7199
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00204D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Debatrayee Dasgupta, Anjali Patel
In the quest for an efficient co-delivery of metformin hydrochloride and glipizide, a nanocarrier was designed using nMCM-48 and 12-tungstophosphoric acid (TPA) to combat the growing concern of diabetes and cancer mortalities.
